mechanics.title: Rift Shards
mechanics.description: Primary progression currency. Earned from missions; spent to unlock new biomes.

mechanics.title: Biome Unlock Gate
mechanics.description: Spends Rift Shards to unlock the next biome and progress the world.

mechanics.title: Storyline / Questline
mechanics.description: Mission chain unlocking items/characters; gates new biomes; some missions need certain items.

mechanics.title: Achievements
mechanics.description: Award players for certain feats in game.

mechanics.title: Death Markers / Ghost Trails
mechanics.description: See where people died on mountains; leave warnings.

mechanics.title: Persistent Player Objects
mechanics.description: Death Stranding-style bridges placed by players, shared across servers for a time.

mechanics.title: Procedural Weekly Mountain
mechanics.description: Generate a new mountain / set of missions each week.

mechanics.title: Hidden Secrets
mechanics.description: Off the track: rare critters, sprays, emotes.

mechanics.title: Feed-to-Grow Hub Pet
mechanics.description: Some weird thing in the hub you can feed for progress.
